decision: We will self-provision the SW onboarding token by idempotent mint-on-use via ProductTokenAdmin, stored in the encrypted app config store, rotated at 7 days left.
options_considered: (a) short-lived signed assertion rejected: SW verifies only api_tokens rows, no shared signing secret exists for this route; a new crypto scheme is forbidden. (b) chosen. Owner directive 2026-11-18 covers the goal; tech-lead reviews the shape.
